name: bag_of_holding_returned_forgets_what_its_earlier_life_exiled
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (mapper M3, Hoarding Dragon's draft; wave E1). Bag of Holding: 'Whenever you discard a card, exile that card from your graveyard. / {2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card. / {4}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return all cards exiled with this artifact to their owner's hand.' The Bag loots Spare A away (exiled by its trigger), then returns to its owner's hand and is put onto the battlefield again: a new object (CR 400.7). Its sacrifice returns only cards exiled with this object (CR 607.2a): none, so Spare A stays in exile. Hand: Spare A, +1 draw -1 discard, +1 the Bag, -1 the Bag = 1. Failed before the fix: IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE read every exile the card's handle caused, across its lives, and Spare A came back (hand 2).
